slides.title: Weak vs. Great Prompts
content: A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A great prompt gets a great answer.
slides.narration:
Have you ever got an unhelpful answer from an AI?
That's often from a weak prompt.
A weak prompt gets a weak answer.
A great prompt gets a great answer.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: Left: Person looking confused at AI output. Right: Person smiling with a helpful AI output.

slides.title: The Three Key Ingredients
content: Clarity
Context
Constraints
slides.narration:
The best prompts have three key ingredients.
These are Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Let's explore each one.
slides.image_prompt: Graphic with three interconnected circles labeled 'Clarity', 'Context', 'Constraints'.

slides.title: 1. Clarity: Be Specific!
content: The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts lead to generic answers.
slides.narration:
First, let's understand Clarity.
Clarity means being specific.
The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts give generic answers.
slides.image_prompt: Section Header: '1. Clarity'. A magnifying glass icon over a question mark.

slides.title: Clarity: Weak Prompt Example
content: Weak Prompt: "Write about electric cars."
slides.narration:
For example, a weak prompt is: 'Write about electric cars.'
This is too broad.
The AI won't know what angle to take.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User types 'Write about electric cars' into ChatGPT. AI generates a generic overview.

slides.title: Clarity: Good Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt (Clear): "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's make it clear.
A good prompt is: 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
See how specific this is?
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User types the clear prompt. AI generates relevant benefits for city dwellers. Side-by-side comparison of outputs from weak vs. good prompt.

slides.title: 2. Context: Give Background!
content: Context tells the AI why you're asking.
Helps AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.narration:
Next, let's add Context.
Context gives background to the AI.
It tells the AI why you're asking.
It helps the AI choose the right perspective.
slides.image_prompt: Section Header: '2. Context'. A thought bubble with background information inside.

slides.title: Context: Better Prompt Example
content: Good Prompt: "Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
Let's take our good prompt.
'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
Now, let's add context for the audience.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User displays the 'Good Prompt' from the previous slide.

slides.title: Context: Improved Prompt
content: Better Prompt (with Context): "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
We have an improved prompt now.
It is for a lifestyle blog.
The blog focuses on sustainable living.
It asks for the top 3 benefits of electric cars.
This is for city dwellers.
The AI now knows the audience.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User modifies the prompt on screen by adding context. AI output is tailored to sustainable living.

slides.title: 3. Constraints: Set the Rules!
content: Constraints are boundaries that shape the output.
Tell AI the length, format, and style you need.
slides.narration:
Finally, let's add Constraints.
Constraints set rules for the output.
They define length, format, and style.
This shapes the AI's response precisely.
slides.image_prompt: Section Header: '3. Constraints'. A ruler icon with boundary lines.

slides.title: Constraints: Excellent Prompt Example
content: Better Prompt: "Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city."
slides.narration:
We have our better prompt.
It is about a lifestyle blog on sustainable living.
It explains the top 3 benefits of electric cars.
This is for city residents.
Now, let's add some rules.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User displays the 'Better Prompt' from the previous slide.

slides.title: Constraints: Fully Improved Prompt
content: Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question to encourage comments."
slides.narration:
We now have an excellent prompt.
It asks for a short blog post, under 400 words.
It targets a lifestyle blog on sustainable living.
It details the top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers.
The tone should be friendly and enthusiastic.
It must end with a question to encourage comments.
The AI knows exactly what to do.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User adds constraints to the prompt. AI output is under 400 words, friendly, enthusiastic, and ends with a question. Side-by-side comparison of outputs from better vs. excellent prompt.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
content: Tell the AI who to be.
This is a super-powerful trick.
slides.narration:
Here's a bonus tip: provide a Persona.
Tell the AI who to be.
This is a super powerful trick.
slides.image_prompt: Section Header: 'Bonus Tip: Persona'. An icon of a person wearing different hats (e.g., chef, doctor, engineer).

slides.title: Persona Example
content: Prompt: "Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food."
slides.narration:
Let's try a persona prompt.
It asks the AI to act as an expert travel agent.
This agent specializes in budget travel.
It creates a 5-day Rome itinerary.
This is for a solo traveler who loves history and food.
The AI will now think like a travel agent.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User types the persona prompt into ChatGPT. AI generates an itinerary from a travel agent's perspective.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Giving Examples
content: Zero-Shot: You give zero examples.
One-Shot: You give one example.
Few-Shot: You give a few examples.
slides.narration:
Another bonus tip: give Examples.
This is called Zero, One, or Few-Shot prompting.
It helps the AI follow a pattern.
slides.image_prompt: Section Header: 'Bonus Tip: Giving Examples'. Icons for 0, 1, and 3 shots, representing examples.

slides.title: Zero-Shot Prompting
content: You give zero examples.
Most prompts are like this.
You just ask for what you want.
slides.narration:
Zero-Shot means you give zero examples.
Most prompts are like this.
You just ask for what you want directly.
Our previous examples were all Zero-Shot.
slides.image_prompt: Simple direct prompt example: 'Tell me a joke.' AI gives a joke.

slides.title: One-Shot Prompting
content: You give one example to show the AI the pattern you want.
Great for specific formatting.
slides.narration:
One-Shot means you give one example.
This shows the AI the pattern you want.
It's great for specific formatting.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration of a prompt structure with one input-output example.

slides.title: One-Shot Example
content: Prompt: "Summarize text into key points like this: Text: 'The sun is a star, and it's the center of our solar system.' Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun' Now, use this format for the following text: [insert long article here]"
slides.narration:
Let's try a One-Shot example.
We ask the AI to summarize text into key points.
We give an example of the desired format.
Text: 'The sun is a star, and it's the center of our solar system.'
Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun'
Then, we ask it to use this format for new text.
The AI will follow this exact format.
slides.image_prompt: Screen recording: User types the one-shot prompt, showing the example and then the request for a long article. AI outputs in the specified format.

slides.title: Few-Shot Prompting
content: You give a few examples to teach the AI a more complex pattern.
slides.narration:
Few-Shot means you give a few examples.
This teaches the AI a more complex pattern.
It's useful for intricate tasks.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing multiple input-output examples to define a pattern.

slides.title: Summary
content: Clarity: Be specific.
Context: Give background.
Constraints: Set rules.
Bonus Tips: Persona, Examples.
slides.narration:
In summary, we learned about the 3 Cs.
Clarity means being specific.
Context provides background.
Constraints set the rules.
We also covered Persona and Example prompting.
slides.image_prompt: Summary slide with icons for Clarity, Context, Constraints, Persona, and Examples.
